mr.title: Marketing report
mr.sub: What marketing cost, against what it brought back
mr.note: Sales counts delivered orders only. Ordered value (orders placed) is shown beside it, never mixed in. Spend is the ad spend imported for each day plus the cost of message sends. This page only reads: it changes no budget, campaign, price or order.
mr.offBody: Turn it on in the settings below to see spend against Ordered value and Sales, by channel, by campaign and per message send.
mr.offAsk: Ask the owner to turn it on.

notes.future: The end was in the future, so the report stops today.
notes.swapped: The dates were the wrong way round, so they were turned round.
notes.tooLong: That was longer than the longest period, so the report shows its last {days} days.

kpi.spendUnknown: A dollar day has no rate yet, so the total is not known

mr.spendUnknown: A dollar day has no rate yet: spend not known

ch.sub: Every order sits in one channel, by the same words as Money › Profit by channel. Ad channels carry their imported spend.
ch.empty: No orders and no spend in this period.

camp.sub: A campaign's orders come through its ad campaigns or its landing pages (each order once); its spend is its ad campaigns' spend.
camp.empty: No campaign had an order or spend in this period.
camp.untied: {amount} of ad spend is on ad campaigns tied to no campaign.

send.sub: Sends started in this period. Their result is what the receivers ordered within {days} days of their message.
send.empty: No message send started in this period.

card.d: Marketing report. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
card.onHelp: Off as it ships. On, this page shows the report.
card.maxDaysHelp: The most days one report covers (7 to 1096). A longer choice shows its last days.
card.resultDaysHelp: How many days after a message its receiver's orders count as that send's result (1 to 60).

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.

mr.csvHelp: The whole report for this period as one spreadsheet file: the shop, each channel, campaign and message send (amounts in paisa, times in UTC).
